				"articleBody": "Fourth set begins.&#xa0;Kang goes first and hits a 9. A 10 for the Indian. The Korean finds a 10 when she needed it the most. A 9 for Kumkum. Set is tied at the moment. Kang’s third arrow is a 10. Kumkum can level it again with a 10 and protect her lead and she does it!&#xa0;Set tied at 29-29 and Kumkum leads 5-3 with one set to go.&#xa0;Another tied set will be enough for the Indian teenager to cause a major upset here.&#xa0;Here’s the final set.&#xa0;Kang starts with a 10. It is a 9 for Kumkum which gives the Korean the advantage. A 9 for Kang with her second arrow. Another 9 for the Indian. Kang can clinch the set with a 10 but it is a 9 for her. A 10 for Kumkum needed to tie the set and she does it!!!She has tied the fifth set 28-28 to eliminate the World Champion Chaeyoung Kang with a 6-4 score.Absolutely stunning performance from the Indian teenager. She will face either Li Tsai-Chi of Chinese Taipei or China’s Jingyi Zhu in the semifinals.&#xa0;",

var apiUrl = (typeof API_URL === "string" && API_URL && cric_comp_id) ? API_URL + "api/cricket/grouped/fixtures/" + encodeURIComponent(cric_comp_id) : "";

// Cache for scorecard data
let scorecardCache = {
data: null,
timestamp: 0,
cacheDuration: 30000 // 30 seconds cache
};
let scorecardApiWarned = false;

function getEmptyScorecardData() {
return {current_matches: [], upcoming_matches: [], results: []};
}

async function scorecarddata() {
const now = Date.now();

// Return cached data if it's still valid
if (scorecardCache.data && (now - scorecardCache.timestamp) < scorecardCache.cacheDuration) {
return scorecardCache.data;
}

try {
if (! apiUrl) {
if (! scorecardApiWarned) {
console.warn("Scorecard API URL is not configured (missing cricket competition id).");
scorecardApiWarned = true;
}
return scorecardCache.data || getEmptyScorecardData();
}

const resultdata = await fetch(apiUrl, {credentials: "same-origin"});
if (! resultdata.ok) {
if (! scorecardApiWarned) {
console.error("Scorecard API request failed:", resultdata.status, apiUrl);
scorecardApiWarned = true;
}
return scorecardCache.data || getEmptyScorecardData();
}

const data = await resultdata.json();

// Update cache
scorecardCache.data = data;
scorecardCache.timestamp = now;

return data;
} catch (error) {
console.error('Error fetching scorecard data:', error);
// Return cached data even if stale if available
return scorecardCache.data || getEmptyScorecardData();
}
}
